1.text: Haleluya.Mushimire Imana ahera hayo,Muyishimire mu isanzure ry'imbaraga zayo.

2.text: Muyishimire iby'imbaraga yakoze,Muyishime nk'uko bikwiriye gukomera kwayo kwinshi.

4.text: Muyishimishe ishako n'imbyino,Muyishimishe ibifite imirya n'imyironge.

5.text: Muyishimishe ibyuma bivuza amajwi mato,Muyishimishe ibyuma birenga.
